summary_1line: After Bali’s funeral, Sugriva is crowned king of Kishkindha, Angada is made heir, and Rama waits through the rainy season before the planned campaign against Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada, weeping, circles the blazing funeral pyre of Bali while Sugriva and the monkeys stand in mourning.
Sugriva sits on a golden throne beneath a white canopy as Hanuman and other monkey chiefs pour sacred waters from golden vessels over him.
Rama and Lakshmana stand at the mouth of a mountain cave while the monkey hosts bow before Sugriva entering the city of Kishkindha.
